<thought>To obtain the possible precursors, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that form a sulfonamide (functional group “sulfonamides”) and break a halide bond (functional group “alkyl halide”). This should retrieve the template describing the reaction of an aromatic amine with a sulfonyl chloride to give a sulfonamide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
